name: Hidden Sniper (Combat)
body:
You are well practiced at striking from a hidden location and concealing yourself again.

Prerequisite: Dex 13, Point Blank Shot, Rapid Shot, Skill Focus (Stealth), base attack bonus +6

Benefit: When sniping, you can choose one of these benefits. You may make a second attack before using Stealth again. This second attack uses your highest BAB, but both attacks suffer a -2 penalty. Alternatively, you can choose to take a -10 penalty to your Stealth after making a single attack.

Normal: You can make a single attack and then use Stealth again, suffering a -20 to the skill check.
